name: Diamond Strap Smartwatch
subtitle: Bluetooth calling with dual straps
description: This round-dial smartwatch combines Bluetooth calling with a 1.99-inch HD LTPS display and two interchangeable straps. Track heart rate, blood pressure, sleep and activities, choose from multiple sports modes, and switch between a diamond-style metal strap and silicone strap.
story: Designed for users who want one watch for different occasions, this smartwatch comes with two distinct strap options. The diamond-style metal strap creates a dressier look, while the silicone strap suits active daily wear. Bluetooth calling keeps compatible phone calls accessible from the wrist, and the large round display provides space for time, notifications and watch information. Wellness and activity features include heart rate, blood pressure and sleep monitoring, along with more than 50 sports modes for tracking different routines.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
